pages.text: Aqua regia is 375 mB of hydrochloric acid and 125 mB of nitric, mixed cold: the royal water that dissolves gold, and the only common acid that takes platinum. It fumes like nitric acid; wear the mask.
pages.title: Aqua regia and ammonia

pages.text: Ammonia is made as Haber and Bosch made it: 750 mB of hydrogen and 250 mB of air over a raw magnetite, the iron catalyst, in a heated basin, give 500 mB and the magnetite back nine times in ten.
250 mB of ammonia and 250 mB of hydrochloric acid meet as white smoke and settle as two ammonium chloride, sal ammoniac, which the refinery precipitates with.
